industry.why: Neutral at industry level because it is split, carried. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): financials and real estate investment trusts were the only sectors bought in the week (Jefferies desk, 17 Oct), Wood favours financials as the diversification from artificial intelligence, and Goldman (16 Oct) says Southern European banks are healthier than in 2011-15; against it, French spreads at decade highs with new spillover to Italy, the sovereign-bank loop. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: C now, B prior. Banks C and Insurance B carry the view; Alternative finance D.

sector.why: Neutral, set deliberately this week (carried C). Component 1 regime, 16-Oct-26 (a discount-rate shock with the first credit crack inside the artificial intelligence chain: United States core inflation re-accelerating on energy, the Fed and Bank of England hikes pulled forward, the US 10-year about 5.1%, the US joined the sell-off and Asia is in washout, defensives bid for four weeks in Europe, European breadth off its three-year lows but in the bottom quarter, the consumer forecast to weaken into winter; sources present 2026-W42): risk-off cuts assets under management and flows (DNB Carnegie expect 'reduced trading velocity' at Avanza after 'recent turbulence in public markets', 14-Oct) while the cases are capital-light, cash-yielding and self-funded, which the regime pays for; EQT reported fee-generating assets ahead of consensus. Banca Mediolanum's memo (Mixed) finds the business congruent and the Italian multiple not. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-16 against 2026-08-14, not week on week: C now, B prior. Balanced; Neutral is a judgement. Counter-case for lower: a bear market compounds through performance and outflows; for higher: wealth managers are the simple yield cases investors crowd to.

geography.why: Underweight, carried unchanged with the reason strengthened. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): the spillover from France to Italy is the new fact this week (Goldman, 16 Oct, 'tentative spillover to Italy'), and the Italian listings in the Pool are bank-heavy (Monte dei Paschi, Credito Emiliano, Mediobanca) beside global businesses (Eni, Saipem, Tenaris, STMicroelectronics, Technoprobe, Reply). Not Double Underweight because Goldman also says contagion risk is lower than in 2011-15, its fragmentation index shows risk 'remains limited', and Southern European banks are healthier; relative strength is not graded by country. Moves to F if the fragmentation index rises or the Italian premium is read above 150 basis points; back to C under 100.
